storyCards.headline: Here We Go: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
C+c Music Factory/f. Williams's "Here We Go" reached #3 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #3 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.

Here We Go was released in 1991.
